autopaterns.fishing.title: Auto fishing
autopaterns.fishing.recast.tip: Delay after a catch (or a reeled-in line) before casting again.
autopaterns.fishing.wait.tip: If nothing bites within this time, the line is reeled in and cast again.
autopaterns.fishing.lead.tip: Anticipation: higher if the zone overshoots the fish.
autopaterns.fishing.clicks.tip: During the fight: repeated right clicks (spam) or held right click. Right click = the zone goes up.
autopaterns.fishing.clean: Trash / sell of the loaded pattern
autopaterns.fishing.clean.tip: Between two catches: trash and sell according to the loaded pattern's options (nothing without a loaded pattern).
autopaterns.fishing.diag.tip: Saves up to 20 images per session in autopaterns/peche-diagnostic.
autopaterns.fishing.prefer.tip: GPU copy: read every tick, checked by a calibration, automatic fallback to screenshots on any problem. Applies at the next start.
autopaterns.fishing.session: Catches: %s · misses: %s · clicks in the last fight: %s
autopaterns.fishing.session.diagOff: Diagnostic disabled for this session (images could not be written).
autopaterns.fishing.help:
Rod in hand, facing water: the mod casts the line, waits for the gauge,
keeps the fish inside the zone (right clicks = the zone goes up),
then casts again. The gauge is read from the screen: do not hide it.
Anticipation: higher if the zone overshoots the fish.
Diagnostic: images in autopaterns/peche-diagnostic.
autopaterns.fishing.fail.cast: the rod does not cast (water too far?)
autopaterns.fishing.fail.reel: the line does not reel in (bobber stuck?)
autopaterns.fishing.fail.noResponse: screen capture does not respond (gauge unreadable)
autopaterns.fishing.fail.read: screen reading impossible (%s) — details in autopaterns/peche-erreur.txt
autopaterns.fishing.diag.off: §eFishing diagnostic disabled for this session: images could not be written (%s).
